meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: Claude 会按代码的语法结构（而不是文字）搜索和改写代码，覆盖 25 种语言，可批量重命名调用、迁移 import 等，并且默认先给预览再改文件。
howto.when: 当你要求查找或重写某种语法形状的代码，例如所有调用、类、import、codemod、YAML 规则时触发；若目标是纯字符串、注释或文件名，则改用 rg。

say.text: 把 src/ 里所有 console.log 重写成 logger.info
say.note: 默认只预览不改文件，确认后再应用

say.text: 找出这个仓库里所有空的 catch 块
say.note: 按语法结构匹配，不是正则

say.text: 帮我验证这个模式能不能用：'\w+'
say.note: 会提示 \w 不支持，应改用 $VAR

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by syntax shape instead of literal text, across 25 languages — e.g. bulk-renaming calls or migrating imports — and previews changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find or rewrite code by structural pattern (calls, classes, imports, codemods, YAML rules); use rg for plain strings, comments or filenames.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log in src/ to logger.info
say_en.note: Dry-run by default; files are written only after you confirm

say_en.text: Find all empty catch blocks in this repo
say_en.note: Matches by syntax tree, not regex
It reports \w is unsupported and to use $VAR
